meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Intelligent refactor command. Triggers: refactor, refactoring, cleanup, restructure, extract, simplify, modernize.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重构代码结构，消除坏味道，提升可维护性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果代码变得难以维护，需要系统性地改善结构
copy.tagline_en: Restructure code, eliminate bad smells, and improve maintainability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your codebase has become hard to maintain and needs systematic structural improvement

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按步骤分析代码、规划重构方案、逐步执行修改，并在每一步后自动运行测试，确保不引入新错误。
howto.when: 当你提到“重构”、“清理”、“简化”等关键词，或要求对文件、模块、项目进行代码重组时触发。

say.text: 重构 src/auth/handler.ts，策略用安全模式
say.note: Claude 会分析该文件并逐步重构，每步后运行测试。

say.text: 把验证逻辑提取到单独模块
say.note: Claude 会先确认目标，然后规划并执行提取操作。

say.text: 清理所有使用已弃用 API 的函数
say.note: Claude 会查找相关代码并逐一替换，同时验证测试。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will analyze code, plan refactoring, execute changes step by step, and run tests after each step to ensure no regressions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "refactor", "cleanup", "simplify", or ask to restructure code at file/module/project scope.

say_en.note: Claude will analyze and refactor the file, running tests after each step.

say_en.text: Extract validation logic into a separate module
say_en.note: Claude will confirm the goal, then plan and execute the extraction.

say_en.text: Clean up all functions using deprecated API
say_en.note: Claude will find related code and replace them one by one, verifying tests.
